description: Use this for a US company revenue, reported earnings, assets, debt, cash flows or historical financial statements. Reads stored SEC Company Facts with period dates and representative filing links. Individual concepts may come from different filings; a period link does not verify every value. Each metric has its own verified start and end dates; earnings and cash flow can cover different durations. Unverified durations remain unknown. Annual and interim periods are separate, and a standalone quarter is not assumed. Each factual row carries its filing link. No current prices, valuation ratios, analyst forecasts or buy verdict.
name: get_stock_fundamentals
title: Read SEC financials
